mechanism: Paroxetine is a potent CYP2D6 inhibitor that may increase ethinyl estradiol metabolism via CYP3A4 induction, potentially reducing contraceptive efficacy, while ethinyl estradiol may increase paroxetine levels through protein binding displacement.
action: Monitor for breakthrough bleeding and reduced contraceptive efficacy; consider alternative antidepressant if contraceptive failure occurs; counsel patient on additional contraceptive methods.
